title: Let's Learn English Lesson 15
subtitle: I Love People-Watching!
attribution: Source: VOA Learning English – Let's Learn English Level 1, Lesson 15: I Love People-Watching! (learningenglish.voanews.com). Public domain. This unofficial study helper is not affiliated with VOA.

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Hello! People from all over the world come to Washington, D.C. When I’m at work, I love eating lunch outside. I like to watch people walking by. They all look very different. Today, my friend Ashley is eating lunch with me.
dialogue.zh: 嗨！世界各地的人都会来华盛顿特区。上班的时候，我喜欢在外面吃午饭。我喜欢看路过的人。他们看起来都不一样。今天，我的朋友阿什莉和我一起吃午饭。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Ashley, today the weather is beautiful, isn’t it?
dialogue.zh: 阿什莉，今天天气真好，对吧？

dialogue.speaker: Ashley
dialogue.en: Yes, it is. Ahh. Ooh, we have to return to work!
dialogue.zh: 是的。啊。哦，我们得回去上班了！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: No, we have time! Let’s people-watch a little more.
dialogue.zh: 不，我们还有时间！再看一会儿路人吧。

dialogue.speaker: Ashley
dialogue.en: Okay.
dialogue.zh: 好吧。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Oh, I know her. She works in my office! Keyana, hi! Come and join us!
dialogue.zh: 哦，我认识她。她在我办公室工作！基亚娜，嗨！过来一起坐吧！

dialogue.speaker: Keyana
dialogue.en: Hi Anna, how are you?
dialogue.zh: 嗨，安娜，你好吗？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: I’m doing great! Keyana, this is my friend Ashley.
dialogue.zh: 我很好！基亚娜，这是我的朋友阿什莉。

dialogue.speaker: Keyana
dialogue.en: Hi, Ashley!
dialogue.zh: 嗨，阿什莉！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: We need to return to work. But the weather is beautiful and people-watching is fun!
dialogue.zh: 我们得回去上班。可天气真好，看路人也很有趣！

dialogue.speaker: Keyana
dialogue.en: I love people-watching too!
dialogue.zh: 我也喜欢看路人！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Well, have a seat! It is fun to see how people are different or the same.
dialogue.zh: 那就坐吧！看看大家哪里不同、哪里相同，很有意思。

dialogue.speaker: Keyana
dialogue.en: It is. For example, Anna, you are tall. But Ashley and I are short.
dialogue.zh: 是啊。比如说，安娜，你很高。可阿什莉和我都很矮。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: And Keyana, you and Ashley have brown eyes; I have blue eyes.
dialogue.zh: 还有，基亚娜，你和阿什莉是棕色眼睛；我是蓝眼睛。

dialogue.speaker: Keyana
dialogue.en: You two have light skin and I have dark skin.
dialogue.zh: 你们俩皮肤较浅，我皮肤较深。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Ashley, you have straight hair. Keyana and I have curly hair.
dialogue.zh: 阿什莉，你是直发。基亚娜和我是卷发。

dialogue.speaker: Ashley
dialogue.en: You have very curly hair, Anna.
dialogue.zh: 安娜，你的头发卷得很厉害。

dialogue.speaker: Keyana
dialogue.en: I need to return to work. See you, Anna! Nice to meet you Ashley!
dialogue.zh: 我得回去上班了。再见，安娜！很高兴认识你，阿什莉！

dialogue.speaker: Ashley
dialogue.en: Bye, Keyana!
dialogue.zh: 再见，基亚娜！

dialogue.speaker: Ashley
dialogue.en: Anna, I have to go, too. Are you returning to work?
dialogue.zh: 安娜，我也得走了。你要回去上班吗？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: I still have time. And this sun feels so good!
dialogue.zh: 我还有时间。这阳光感觉真好！

dialogue.speaker: Ashley
dialogue.en: Um, Anna, what does your boss look like?
dialogue.zh: 嗯，安娜，你的老板长什么样？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: She is short. She has straight, light hair.
dialogue.zh: 她个子矮。她是直的浅色头发。

dialogue.speaker: Ashley
dialogue.en: Does she wear glasses?
dialogue.zh: 她戴眼镜吗？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Yes. Yes, she does.
dialogue.zh: 是的。她戴眼镜。

dialogue.speaker: Ashley
dialogue.en: Is she wearing a blue sweater today?
dialogue.zh: 她今天穿着蓝毛衣吗？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: How do you know that?
dialogue.zh: 你怎么知道的？

dialogue.speaker: Ashley
dialogue.en: She’s coming this way.
dialogue.zh: 她正朝这边走来。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Oh no! Hide me!
dialogue.zh: 哦不！把我藏起来！

dialogue.speaker: Ashley
dialogue.en: Um, bye, Anna. Call me later.
dialogue.zh: 嗯，再见，安娜。回头给我打电话。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Bye, Ashley! Talk to you later!
dialogue.zh: 再见，阿什莉！回头聊！

dialogue.speaker: Caty
dialogue.en: Anna? Is that you?
dialogue.zh: 安娜？是你吗？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Ms. Weaver! Hi!
dialogue.zh: 韦弗女士！嗨！

dialogue.speaker: Caty
dialogue.en: What are you doing behind that bench?
dialogue.zh: 你在长椅后面干什么？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: I am looking for my, my … stick. Here it is.
dialogue.zh: 我在找我的、我的……棍子。在这儿。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: I am people-watching. Oh! But it’s time to return to work!
dialogue.zh: 我在看路人。哦！可是该回去上班了！

dialogue.speaker: Caty
dialogue.en: No need to hurry. I love people-watching too! Let’s sit!
dialogue.zh: 不用着急。我也喜欢看路人！我们坐下吧！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Sure! Ahh.
dialogue.zh: 好啊！啊。

dialogue.speaker: Caty
dialogue.en: It’s a beautiful day, isn’t it?
dialogue.zh: 今天天气真好，对吧？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Yes. Yes, it is, Ms. Weaver.
dialogue.zh: 是的。是的，韦弗女士。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: People-watching in D.C. is fun. It makes me forget the time!
dialogue.zh: 在特区看路人很有趣。它让我忘了时间！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Until next time! Ahh.
dialogue.zh: 下次见！啊。

quiz.prompt: What do Anna and her friends like to do at lunch?
What does Anna say her boss looks like?
